deadline: explicit trusted work-plan limits.deadlineAt persists atomically with native admission and immutable claim binding; future DB wall-clock deadline required; no production duration default or renewable lease
old_admission_bypass: six-argument preflight EXECUTE revoked from coordinator; owner-only historical synthetic generic path unchanged
late_worker: native bound claim is not current at or after its stored deadline, even before detector invocation; no stage advance or native authority handoff
detector: after successful distinct scheduled queue check and before any new preflight; DB clock and stored maxClaims bound; active runs only; missing deadline or overflow fails whole review; no guessed cutoff
lock: refresh_control held across durable phase observation and stop recording; concurrent reviewers cannot duplicate hold or release
execution: all deadline interruptions are uncertain EXECUTION; known call phase is preserved and is not proof that local or external work terminated; full reservation and account hold retained in ALL three cases
repeated_review: held account skipped; no repeated incident/version or fairness turn; generic acknowledgement cannot resolve uncertain execution even when call phase is known
healthy_work: unexpired work untouched; unrelated accounts continue only within remaining real budget; no promise of unlimited progress if retained reservations fill capacity
queue_success: durable queue-check result remains separate from detector failure; failed/missing detector blocks dispatch and does not forge a refresh success
handoff: ready_for_dataset contains no durable product rows; interruption is not Dataset success, checkpoint advancement, data zero or permission to refetch
remaining: verified runtime and all external execution termination before explicit recovery/release
native authenticated cron and independent alarm/witness/notification/ack activation
production workload/date/deadline clock and SQL timeouts measured after product-level discussion
verification: unit boundary tests plus five durable native-preflight phase scenarios and concurrent reviewers in the two existing ephemeral CI databases; no native provider call or process-termination claim
